review.rationale: The recommendation correctly preserves the FAIL_CLOSED_LOCAL_EXPECTED_GOVERNANCE_SHA_BINDING_ERROR without reinterpreting it as PASS, explicitly retains the failure record, and proposes exactly one bounded non-mutating corrected preflight that uses remote-resolved governance SHA and full re-verification. It does not authorize silent retry, mutation, merge, release, or deployment, and it preserves the unconsumed Draft→Ready and merge caps (1/1/1/0) strictly contingent on the corrected preflight passing. Root cause (manual transcription of abbreviated commit into unbound inline command) is consistent with the failure record, and authority boundaries remain intact pending a separate Human Decision and qwen3.7-max review.
